title: Can't even ping the network printer
description: I can't connect to the HR printer, it doesn't even respond to ping. It used to work fine.

worklogs.description: Determined the printer is on VLAN 30, confirmed the user is on VLAN 10.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, the printer is on the HR department's VLAN. I asked the network team to add an ACL rule for the VLAN 10 → VLAN 30 printer port. In the meantime, so I can confirm, could you share the printer's IP (something like 10.0.30.x) and the make/model?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: IP is 10.0.30.45, model HP LaserJet Pro M404dn. By the way, I heard Ashley is having the same problem.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Opened an ACL change request for printing traffic from VLAN 10 to 30 (CR-2841). Asked Ashley to open a separate ticket — I need to clarify the scope of impact.
